drawer.title: User Access and Control
drawer.subtitle: Assign Owning Departments, Zones, and Workflow Stages for user access
drawer.step1Description: Select the Owning Department(s) this user has permission to manage.
drawer.step2Description: Select specific Zone(s) and Ward(s) to grant access. Use Select All to allocate the entire zone or pick specific wards.
drawer.optionalZoneNote: Optional: If no zone or ward is selected, this user will have access across all zones.
drawer.validationDepartmentRequired: At least one Owning Department is required.
drawer.updateSubtitle: Modify Owning Departments, Zones, and Workflow Stages for user access
drawer.successMessage: User department and zone allocations saved successfully.
drawer.updateSuccessMessage: User department and zone allocations updated successfully.
drawer.zoneWiseDescription: Select a Zone from the dropdown, then select specific Ward(s) via checkboxes to grant access. Use Select All to allocate an entire zone or pick individual wards.
drawer.wardWiseDescription: Select Zone and assign Ward(s) this user has permission to manage.
drawer.noZoneSelectedPrompt: Please select a zone from the dropdown on the left to view and select its wards.
drawer.wardWiseNotice: Select a Zone from the dropdown, then pick multiple wards via checkboxes. Your ward selections for each zone are automatically preserved when switching between zones.
drawer.noWardsForZone: No active wards found for this zone
drawer.step3Description: Select the grievance workflow stages this user has access permissions to process.
drawer.searchStagesPlaceholder: Search Grievance Stages by code or name...
drawer.noStagesAvailable: No active grievance workflow stages found.
drawer.inactiveUserNotice: This user is inactive. Allocation cannot be performed or modified for inactive users.
